versions.changelog: processon-diagrams is deprecated, please use processon-diagramgen.

- Initial public release of the processon-diagrams skill.
- Supports automatic identification of diagram types (e.g., flowcharts, architecture, sequence, network topology, ER, org charts, timelines, infographics).
- Engages users in clarifying requirements if input is ambiguous or incomplete.
- Provides prompt optimization for professional and visually appealing diagrams based on diagram type.
- Integrates with ProcessOn MCP service when available, with local Python script fallback if not.
- Clearly informs users about skill activation and output location, and supplies guidance for credential setup if needed.
